info.description: Register -> Admin approval -> Login, operations_manager role + per-user upload rights, upload-endpoint gating, and the booking/investor dashboards. Import this file directly into Postman (Import > File) and run the whole collection top to bottom with the Collection Runner — tokens and IDs are captured automatically into collection variables as each request runs. Fill in adminEmail/adminPassword (and opsManagerPassword, if you're seeding that role too) in the collection's Variables tab before running — they're intentionally left blank here so real credentials never end up committed to the repo.
